summary: Recent updates to the Web Speech feature in Firefox have focused on improving how it handles audio interruptions during speech processing. Specifically, the browser now **blocks self-starting of Web Speech when the audio session is interrupted**, which helps prevent confusion and enhances user experience when speaking commands or dictating text. Additionally, there has been a cleanup in the management of the Web Speech task lifecycle, streamlining operations to make the feature more efficient. This refinement ensures that users have a smoother interaction with voice recognition capabilities, particularly in scenarios where background audio might otherwise disrupt the speech recognition process.
